name: Arrow of Whirling Winds
summary:
This arrow feels almost weightless. It’s head is a smooth grey cone with a spiral grove, and its fletching flutters as if buffeted by wind when there is none.

These arrows are often used against enemy archers to drive them out of cover or off high ground. Their use in siege warfare mandated magical countermeasures.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 1

AMMUNITION OF WHIRLING WINDS (1)
When you Attack using this ammunition, you create a 6 Space high, 3 Space diameter Cylinder of swirling winds centered in the target’s Space for 1 minute. Creatures in the area are Slowed 2, Blinded, and Fully Concealed. When a creature enters the area for the first time on its turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Might Save against your Save DC. Save Failure: They’re pushed 1 Space horizontally in a random direction. Failure (each 5): They’re pushed 1 additional Space.

name: Graveward Brooch
summary:
This unassuming circular brooch is covered in faint yet intricate symbols of life and protection. When worn, it gives its wearer a slight feeling of ease.

The brooches are popular amongst nobles at high risk of assassination and those who just think they are. They are frequently hidden under other jewelry so would-be attackers don’t expect their protection.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 1

GRAVEWARD (3)
While this is equipped, if you take damage that reduces you to 0 HP or lower, you immediately regain 3 HP. If this would heal you above 0 HP, you do not gain Exhaustion from dropping below 0 HP from the damage.

name: Elemental Arrow of Fire
summary:
This arrow is warm to touch. It’s tipped with an obsidian shard with a red sheen and it has vibrant red fletching.

These arrows are frequently used by hunters for monsters weak against fire. While they are rarer and harder to obtain than mundane burning arrows, they’re also more effective and easier to use.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 1

FIRE AMMUNITION: BURNING (1)
This deals Fire damage.

When you Attack with this, the target makes a Repeated Physical Save. Save Failure: The target begins Burning 2 for 1 minute.

magicFeatures.name: Fire Ammunition: Burning
magicFeatures.description:
This deals Fire damage.

When you Attack with this, the target makes a Repeated Physical Save. Save Failure: The target begins Burning 2 for 1 minute.

name: Elemental Arrow of Ice
summary:
This arrow is covered in frost. It’s head is a hollow glass cone filled with 2 different liquids separated by a thin membrane and an extrusion near the base of the pin that, when pressed, breaks the membrane and allows the liquids to mix. The arrow’s fletching is white with a blue sheen.

These arrows are among the first creations taught to budding alchemists. Their design covers many fundamentals of alchemic reactions.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 1

FROST AMMUNITION: FROST BOMB (1)
This deals Cold damage.

You can spend 1 AP to prime this for 1 minute. When you Attack with this while it’s primed, compare your Attack Check against the AD of every other target within 1 Space of the original target. Hit: The target takes 1 Cold damage.

name: Elemental Arrow of Electricity
summary:
This arrow vibrates slightly when not notched. It’s tipped with copper that sparks when close to flesh and it has yellow fletching with a jagged edge.

Particularly clever and skilled archers have been known to use these arrows’ magically properties to ricochet them toward targets behind cover.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 1

LIGHTNING AMMUNITION: CHAIN (1)
This deals Electric damage.

When you Attack with this, choose 1 additional target within 3 Spaces of the original target using the same Attack for all targets.

This deals Electric damage.

name: Elemental Arrow of Acid
summary:
This arrow smells sour. It’s tipped with a slightly corroded iron head that stings when touched and the arrow has black fletching.

Legends tell that these arrows were first designed by a wizard who crafted them to destroy the thick armor of an army of golems that fell out of his command, leading to their destruction.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 1

CORROSIVE AMMUNITION: DISSOLVE (1)
This deals Corrosion damage.

When you Attack with this, the target makes a Repeated Agility Save. Save Failure: The target no longer benefits from PDR or EDR for 1 minute.

name: Elemental Arrow of Poison
summary:
This arrow smells bitter. It’s tipped with a dire bee stinger and has green fletching.

These arrows are commonly used to weaken their target without killing it. It’s commonly used by poachers to capture rare animals for private, and often illegal, menageries.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 1

POISON AMMUNITION: DEBILITATING POISON (1)
This deals Poison damage.

When you Attack with this, the target makes a Repeated Might Save. Save Failure: The target is afflicted by a Basic Poison for 1 minute. Creatures Poisoned by this are Hindered or Impaired (your choice when you Attack).

magicFeatures.name: Poison Ammunition: Debilitating Poison

This deals Poison damage.

When you Attack with this, the target makes a Repeated Might Save. Save Failure: The target is afflicted by a Basic Poison for 1 minute. Creatures Poisoned by this are Hindered or Impaired (your choice when you Attack).

name: Bag of Wind
summary:
This ox-hide pouch shakes in place from the torrential winds trapped inside. It is held shut by a drawsting slip knot.

The Bag of Wind was a failed creation intended to hasten ship sailing. Unfortunately, the amount of wind needed to significantly shorten any voyage far exceeded what the bag could contain.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 5

CONTAINED WIND (5)
You can spend 2 AP to open the bag and direct some of the contained wind. Make a Spell Check Contested by the Might Save of each creature in a 3 Space Cone. You’re considered as Medium sized for the purposes of moving creatures with this effect. Success: The target is pushed 3 Space away from you. Success (each 5): The target is pushed 1 additional Space.

name: Holy Water
summary:
This blessed water is stored in a silver vial embossed with the holy symbols of the god or goddess whose priests have blessed the water.

Blessed by a priest or paladin, Holy Water is commonly used to cleanse minor ailments and to ward off dark creatures.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 1

HOLY WATER (2)
Apply to Creature: You can use the Object Action to apply the Holy Water to yourself on an adjacent creature that isn’t a Fiend or Undead. Remove 1 stack of all the following Conditions from the target: Dazed, Deafened, Exposed, Hindered, Impaired, Intimidated, Slowed, Stunned, or Taunted.

Throw: You can spend 2 AP recite a short incantation, then throw the Holy Water (it is a Micro Object). Make a Spell Attack against the AD of all Fiends and Undead within a 1 Space Aura of where it lands. Hit: Target takes 3 Radiant damage.

Coat Weapon: You can use the Object Action to apply the Holy Water to a weapon a weapon. That weapon deals +1 Radiant damage to Fiends and Undead for 1 minute.

name: Potion of Agility
summary:
This bright yellow potion swirls in its thin glass vial, moving more like a thick gas than a liquid.

This potion is in high demand for thieves and assassins, causing many kingdoms to heavily control its sale. This makes it a popular item for smugglers and black markets.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 1

ENHANCE ATTRIBUTE: AGILITY (4)
You can use the Object Action to drink this potion or apply it to an adjacent creature. The target gains ADV on Agility Checks and Saves until they Long Rest.

magicFeatures.name: Enhance Attribute: Agility
magicFeatures.description: You can use the Object Action to drink this potion or apply it to an adjacent creature. The target gains ADV on Agility Checks and Saves until they Long Rest.

name: Elixir of Hydrablood
summary:
This thick red sludge smells rotten and tastes worse, but its rejuvenating effects feel euphoric. It’s steel flask is engraved with the depiction of a hydra whose heads curl around and cover the entire container.

When a warrior king lost both his legs in battle, he commissioned an archmage to heal him. Over 50 hydras were slain for materials in an effort to capture their regenerative properties, eventually leading to this potion.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 1

RAPID REGENERATION (9)
You can use the Object Action to drink this potion or apply it to an adjacent creature. The target regains 3 HP immediately and at the start of each turn for 1 minute. If the target has any missing limbs, they grow back over the duration.

magicFeatures.name: Rapid Regeneration
magicFeatures.description: You can use the Object Action to drink this potion or apply it to an adjacent creature. The target regains 3 HP immediately and at the start of each turn for 1 minute. If the target has any missing limbs, they grow back over the duration.

name: Bag of Badger Beads
summary:
This black leather pouch stylized as a badger’s face contains small black and white striped beads that vibrate when touched.

While frequently used for pranks and minor distractions, Badger Beads have been used in place of sappers to quickly burrow alchemical bombs underneath fortifications from a safe distance away.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 5

SUMMON BADGER (5)
You can use the Object Action to pull a bead out of the bag and throw it (it is a Micro Object). The bead transforms into a creature with the statistics of a Badger. The Badger disappears after 1 hour or if the user doesn’t Sustain this effect on their Turn.

The creature shares your Initiative, acting on your turn. You can command it to take any Actions or Reactions available to it (except the Sustain Action), but must spend its own AP to do so. When you take the Move Action, the creature also gains the benefits of the Move Action. If you don’t command it, it takes the Dodge Action.

name: Potion of Shifting Size
summary:
This dark purple potion continuously pulses, expanding and contracting, causing it to slosh against the sides of its glass vial. It smells and tastes somewhat like elderberries.

These potions are sometimes kept by town guard captains and traveling merchants, used in emergencies when monsters attack to scare them off with a massive increase in the the drinker’s size.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 1

SHIFTING SIZE (3)
You can use the Object Action to drink this potion or apply it to an adjacent creature. Once per round for 1 minute, when consuming this potion or by spending 1 AP the target can increase or decrease their Size by 1 category. At the end of the duration, the target immediately returns to their regular size.

name: Brittle Bone Key
summary:
This is a long, thin key carved from bone and covered in tiny fractures. With a quiet crack, it shatters into bone dust upon use.

These keys are quick and easy to use, but easily thwarted by even the barest of magical protection. Some enchanters create them in bulk for the sole purpose of driving up the demand for their own magical locks.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 1

BRITTLE BONE KEY (1)
You can use the Object Action to insert the Brittle Bone Key into the keyhole of an adjacent mundane lock and unlock it.

magicFeatures.name: Brittle Bone Key
magicFeatures.description: You can use the Object Action to insert the Brittle Bone Key into the keyhole of an adjacent mundane lock and unlock it.

name: Potion of Ghostwalking
summary:
This translucent liquid in a crystal vial has a faint blue hue with wisps of slightly darker blue twirling within it. It has no discernible smell or taste and cannot even be felt when touched or swallowed.

This potion is an incredible tool for infiltration, allowing its drinker to bypass any form of physical security. It is also helpful in making a quick escape through obstacles impassable by pursuers.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 1

GHOSTWALKING (5)
You can use the Object Action to drink this potion or apply it to an adjacent creature. The target gains a Fly Speed equal to their Speed and can move through solid objects and creatures for 1 minute. If they end your turn inside an object or creature, they take True damage equal to 25% of their maximum HP.

name: Golden Medicinal Apple
summary:
This dazzling golden apple has an almost metallic sheen. Its smell and taste varies by person, catering to be the most delicious fruit the consumer has ever tasted.

Some royalty eat this fruit at every meal, both for its delectable taste and to thwart potential poisons.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 1

TREAT POISON AND DISEASE (5)
You can use the Object Action to consume this or apply it to an adjacent creature. The target is cured of all Basic Poisons and Diseases with a DC of 20 or lower and no longer suffers their effects.

magicFeatures.name: Treat Poison and Disease
magicFeatures.description: You can use the Object Action to consume this or apply it to an adjacent creature. The target is cured of all Basic Poisons and Diseases with a DC of 20 or lower and no longer suffers their effects.

name: Flawed Potion of Truesight
summary:
This almost transparent potion has a slight cloudiness making it faintly visible in its crystal vial. It smells and tastes like fresh spring water yet has a vaguely bitter aftertaste.

This flawed attempts at making a true Potion of Truesight can be the perfect tool to use in an opportune moment.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 1

FLAWED TRUESIGHT (3)
You can use the Object Action to drink this potion or apply it to an adjacent willing creature. The target gains a 10 Space Truesight for 1 minute. If they already have Truesight, it increases by 5 Spaces for the duration. After 1 minute, the target is Blinded for 1 hour.

If they already have Truesight, it increases by 5 Spaces for the duration. After 1 minute, the target is Blinded for 1 hour.

name: Wild Magic Crystal
summary:
This crystal is a ever shifting rainbow of colors including some that are incomprehensible. It’s beautiful to behold, but staring can cause odd, intrusive thoughts that become crazier and more compelling the longer you look.

The crystalized essence of wild magic, these crystals are used by the foolish or desperate and are often more hindrance than help.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
• Uses: 1

WILD MAGIC BURST (1)
You can use the 2 AP to crack the crystal, then throw it (it is a Micro Object). Make a Spell Check contested by a Charisma Save of all creatures within a 1 Space Aura of where it lands. Success: The target rolls on the Wild Magic Table. The effect lasts for 1 Round.
